003.name: Rin
003.text:
But this place is so big it's beginning to give
			me vertigo.

004.name: Rin
004.text:
Shouldn't I have gotten to the other 
			side of this library right now?

009.name: Patchouli
009.text:
Sorry, but the library is closed and I'm not in the mood
			for small talk.

010.name: Rin
010.text: Oh dear, are you being affected by the dreary weatger outside too?

011.name: Patchouli
011.text:
My asthma has nothing to do with current events, 
			although that mist has put me in a bad mood.

012.name: Patchouli
012.text: Been spending all day preparing to clean up after Remilia's mess.

014.name: Patchouli
014.text:
I assume you're here to dispel the mist? Remilia is stubborn and
			once she gets an idea she will go on with it.

015.name: Patchouli
015.text:
That ritual is going to end up very very poorly. And I'm here making
			sure we can deal with the worst once Remilia comes crying
			at me to fix it.

016.name: Rin
016.text: Why don't you go stop her then?

017.name: Patchouli
017.text:
She has an ability to simply get what she wants. 
			This is not metaphorical.

018.name: Patchouli
018.text:
Say you haven't seen any strange youkai around lately right?
			Those who are walking in this mist like it's regular air.

019.name: Patchouli
019.text: Whose affinity fits this current weather like a second nature?

020.name: Rin
020.text: ... I don't remeber seeing any out of place youkai.

021.name: Patchouli
021.text: We might have some time then.

025.name: Patchouli
025.text:
Think of it as a test of strength. There's not much a regular human
			like you can do against Remilia, but it's worth a try.

026.name: Rin
026.text: I feel like this is completely unneccesary!

027.name: Patchouli
027.text: Too bad, I have nothing else to say to you.
